client.title: You bring the brief. We ship the build.
client.desc: For businesses with a clear need and a budget. The Chalyb team designs, builds and launches platforms, apps and AI-driven systems — ready to run and grow.

2.title: Architecture

3.title: MVP

4.title: Iteration
4.body: Feedback loops, real users, measured improvements. We ship continuously.

5.title: Scale & hand-off
5.body: Production-ready architecture, fully documented, with a clean hand-off or ongoing support.

partner.title: Got the idea, not the tech?
partner.desc: Plenty of smart people have good ideas and no way to build them. The Chalyb partnership hub closes that gap — you bring the vision, we bring the team and the engineering.

hero.title: You don't need a budget. You need a builder.
hero.p1: This isn't a client job — it's a partnership. If you have a real idea and the drive to push it, but not the budget to hire a dev team, this is the door. We look at it together, and if it's a fit, we build it together.
hero.p2: Chalyb becomes your technical partner for the project — design, architecture, build and launch — and we share in what it becomes.

1.title: You bring
1.body: The idea, the market insight, the drive, the domain knowledge.

2.title: We bring
2.body: Architecture, full-stack build, cloud infrastructure, launch and iteration.

3.title: We share
3.body: Equity aligned to the level of work, risk and participation on each side.

1.title: Pitch the idea
1.body: A real conversation first. Then we decide together whether it's worth moving forward formally.

2.title: Scope & fit
2.body: We weigh up the build, the workload, and whether it's a partnership that makes sense for both sides.

3.title: Structure the deal
3.body: Equity split agreed up front — based on the work involved and each person's input. Clear, fair, written down.

4.title: Build & launch
4.body: We engineer it, launch it, and keep improving it — as partners in the outcome, not a vendor on the clock.

equity.note: On equity: the split matches the work, risk and effort each side puts in. No two deals are the same — bring the idea and we work out what's fair, together, before anything starts.

earn.title: Sign in. Deploy a system. Scale on demand.
earn.desc: Automate operations, content and workflows through AI-driven agents. The Chalyb platform hosts a growing library of bots and intelligent systems, with a community of operators running them alongside you.

bots.title: A library of intelligent systems. One platform.
bots.p: Create a free account with Google and access the full library — trading, content, scraping, ops automation, AI agents. Test any system in simulation before going live. New tools ship continuously.

feat1.t: Connect with Google and run any system in simulation mode.

feat2.t: Dashboards, metrics and execution history — the same tools we build for ourselves.

feat3.t: Unlock one system or full access through a secure gateway.

feat4.t: New systems and capabilities land as we deploy them.

welcome.title: Welcome to Chalyb
welcome.body: This is your workspace. Here's the essentials in a minute — you can see it later or close it anytime.

nav.title: Your menu
nav.body: Navigate everything from here, grouped into Your account, Platform and Settings. Switch sections in one click.

engines.title: Your engines
engines.body: Under “My engines” you view, open and activate engines (ChalybClip, ChalybCrypto and more). “Live” = running; “Available” = ready to use on your plan.

tokens.title: Your token balance
tokens.body: Under “Usage” you check how many AI tokens you have left this month and your consumption. Out of tokens? Top up or upgrade.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: Under “Subscription” you compare Free, Pro and VIP and switch plans. “Billing” has your payments and receipts.

account.title: Your info
account.body: Under “Profile & security” you update your details, change your password and enable two-factor auth.

help.title: Need help?
help.body: “Messages” is a direct line to the Chalyb team, and “Help” has guides and support. We've got you.

academy.title: The operator network — Chalyb Academy
academy.p: The platform isn't just tools — it's an operator network. Chalyb Academy is the community where builders and operators learn the systems, share what works, and run alongside each other. Free, Premium and VIP tiers, hosted on Skool. Deeper integration into this platform is on the roadmap.

position.line: We build real systems that have to run, scale, and stay live in production.

operate.title: We deliver like a team that runs real systems, not freelancers.
operate.desc: Every project runs on the same practices we use on our own live systems. That's what sets a serious technical partner apart from a typical agency.

1.title: Automated deploys
1.body: Every release automated, tested and repeatable. Nothing pushed by hand.

2.title: Infrastructure as code
2.body: AWS managed with Terraform. Nothing set up by clicking around the console.

3.title: Live monitoring
3.body: Dashboards, alerts and execution history — the same tools we build for clients.

4.title: Separate environments
4.body: Dev, staging and production kept apart, with checks before anything goes live. No surprises.

5.title: Easy rollbacks
5.body: Gradual rollouts by default. A bad release never takes the live site down.

6.title: Security reviews
6.body: Role-based access, two-factor sign-in, rotating secrets, least-privilege access. Built in, not added later.

7.title: Documented hand-off
7.body: Runbooks, architecture diagrams and decision logs. Your team can take it over cleanly.

8.title: Weekly demos
8.body: Working software every week. Always something you can try, never just talk.

9.title: Cloud cost monitoring
9.body: AWS budgets, alerts on odd spend, tagged resources. We don't burn your money.

items.4: Fewer meetings, more getting things done

founder.title: Not a brand. A team.
founder.body: Founder-led, with cloud architecture leadership at a major global payments processor, hands-on PCI DSS 4.0 experience across multi-account AWS organizations, and a track record of delivering multi-tenant SaaS, sensor systems and trading infrastructure. We work the way we build — direct, technical, and reachable when it matters.
